_comment: A CustomResourceDefinition as the API server serves one, trimmed to the half kubeNimbus reads: spec.group / spec.names / spec.versions[].additionalPrinterColumns. The whole openAPIV3Schema is deliberately absent — it is megabytes on a real cert-manager CRD and nothing here looks at it, which is also why the app fetches one CRD at a time rather than listing them all. The columns below are cert-manager's own, verbatim from certificates.cert-manager.io: the Ready column is a condition filter, Issuer and Status are priority 1 (kubectl -o wide only, i.e. this app's advanced view), and the declared Age is folded into the list's own live Age column.

additionalPrinterColumns.name: Issuer
additionalPrinterColumns.description: The name of the issuer that issued this certificate
